 ;; corner picks the boolean op (TL=union, TR=intersect, BL=xor, else A-B);
 ;; output = op(A, B) painted in 8 on an A-sized canvas.
 (let () (define (render-same-size cells h w (color 8)) (paint-cells (empty-grid h w 0) (filter (lambda (p) (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w)) cells) color)) (define (panel-occ panel) (sort (filter (lambda (p) (let ((v (at panel (first p) (second p)))) (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 9))))) (grid-positions panel)) cell<)) (define (split-rows-9 grid) (let loop ((r 0) (start 0) (acc (list))) (cond ((>= r (rows grid)) (reverse (if (< start (rows grid)) (cons (subgrid grid start 0 (- (rows grid) 1) (- (cols grid) 1)) acc) acc))) ((all? (lambda (c) (= (at grid r c) 9)) (range 0 (cols grid))) (let scan ((rr r)) (if (and (< rr (rows grid)) (all? (lambda (c) (= (at grid rr c) 9)) (range 0 (cols grid)))) (scan (+ rr 1)) (loop rr rr (if (< start r) (cons (subgrid grid start 0 (- r 1) (- (cols grid) 1)) acc) acc))))) (else (loop (+ r 1) start acc))))) (define (union-cells panels) (sort (remove-duplicates (flatmap panel-occ panels)) cell<)) (define (inter-cells a b) (let ((bb (panel-occ b))) (filter (lambda (p) (member? p bb)) (panel-occ a)))) (define (minus-cells a b) (let ((bb (panel-occ b))) (filter (lambda (p) (not (member? p bb))) (panel-occ a)))) (define (xor-cells a b) (append (minus-cells a b) (minus-cells b a))) (define (op-from-header header) (let ((cells (panel-occ header))) (cond ((member? (list 0 0) cells) 1) ((member? (list 0 (- (cols header) 1)) cells) 2) ((member? (list (- (rows header) 1) 0) cells) 3) (else 4)))) (let* ((panels (split-rows-9 g)) (header (first panels)) (a (second panels)) (b (third panels)) (op (op-from-header header)) (cells (cond ((= op 1) (union-cells (list a b))) ((= op 2) (inter-cells a b)) ((= op 3) (xor-cells a b)) (else (minus-cells a b))))) (render-same-size cells (rows a) (cols a) 8))))
